'''Dunkleosteus''' is an [[extinct]] [[aquatic]] fish from the [[wikipedia:Devonian|Devonian]] era, found in [[temperate]] or [[tropical]] [[savage]] [[ocean]]s. Larger than a [[Great white shark]], its front half is covered in bony scales called [[wikipedia:scute|scutes]]. As with all other non-vermin sea creatures, capturing the Dunkleosteus requires a modified [[drowning chamber]]. This can be used as a source of large quantities of meat.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] dunkleosteus for their ''bony scutes''.
